fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-03-18 at about 08:15, it was reported that the complainant found the pocket emptied of cash (about Rs. 8,500) after boarding a crowded bus near Anbu Layout Bus Stand Area in Thanjavur. Jothi Bai approached Thanjavur East PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000471. The incident reportedly occurred on or near a bus bearing registration TN-45-ZZ-1062. Praveen Natarajan (9000000041) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage, a witness statement and a vehicle observation.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: CCTV footage; Witness statement; Vehicle observation
fields.Modus_Operandi: Wallet allegedly lifted from a pocket in a crowded queue. The incident reportedly took place on a bus.
fields.Keywords: pickpocketing, wallet, bus stand, bus, morning, witness statement, CCTV, witness
